payload.title: File:Yamatosaurus Dentary.webp
payload.artist_html: Yoshitsugu Kobayashi, Ryuji Takasaki, Katsuhiro Kubota & Anthony R. Fiorillo
payload.credit_html: A new basal hadrosaurid (Dinosauria: Ornithischia) from the latest Cretaceous Kita-ama Formation in Japan implies the origin of hadrosaurids
payload.description_html: Photograph of the right dentary of the holotype (MNHAH D1-033516) of the hadrosaurid Yamatosaurus izanagii (Kobayashi et al. 2021). A is the lateral view; B is the medial view; C is the dorsal view; D is the ventral view; E is the anterior view. The white numbers (B) show the positions of nutrient foramina.
